title: Feature Request - Notification mods for Android O(reo)
body:
I just upgraded from Nougat Note 5 to Oreo 8.1 Pixel 2 XL and am seeing some pretty noticeable and unwanted Notification behavior with xdrip+.  For whatever reason, even with the two notification settings unchecked in xdrip+, notification is always on top and expanded showing the graph.  I wish there was a way to deprecate the priority of that notification.  Since I have it on all the time, I'd rather it was always at the bottom of my list of notifications.

However, in Oreo, it looks like you can set multiple states for the notifications and I think "low importance" is always at the bottom of the notification list.  It would be really great if xdrip+ implemented this new "notification channel" system.  You can see in the screen shot, xdrip+ notification is expanded, by default, I have to manually collapse it... but there is this very slim notification at the bottom for Google weather, which can be expanded... if xdrip+ could implement similar behavior, that acted like the Google weather example, that would be great.

PS - I've got "high priority notifications" and "public notification" unchecked but that doesn't seem to affect things in any event.  Maybe on Nougat it did but in Oreo it seems those settings don't do anything.

![screenshot_20180227-125259](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6887761/36751644-f9ec7df6-1bbd-11e8-98fb-848766c3d8dc.png)

comments.body:
And if you try this?
Settings » less common settings » other misc settings » run collector in foreground

hartlijn, I have that set already.  My impression on that one is that it is needed just to have xdrip+ notifications... I've had that set since day one.  I'm looking for more "fine grained" functionality for the notification as explained in my OP.

Looks like this may have already been tackled in issue [204 ](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/204) but I can't figure out how to get the Android O notifications to work.  I enabled the notification channels settings but see no changes.

I'm hoping that the commits from issue 204 will allow oreo users to set the importance of the ongoing notification to "low" so it will drop to the bottom of the stack but so far I'm not seeing that the app gives that choice.
